Description.DefaultText: Net standing for the village: the civic score (built cottages, the Well, the River Bridge, a Market Stall milestone, completed villager errands) minus the player's own Village Crime notoriety. Shown as a Mental attribute in the character menu, and mirrored onto Village Hall's Notice Board (SpecialDurability1, floored at 0 since that bar can't show a negative value) once the Hall exists; drives the Market Stall renown reward and the blueprint reveal thresholds once positive enough.
